issue_context.title: `CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y` broken with `CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE=y`
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The new ztest API (`CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y`) is broken when used in combination with `CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE=y`. There are no in-tree tests of this combination.

One some platforms (e.g. `qemu_cortex_m3`) the test added below fails the assert, indicating the test case is not running in user space after all. On other platforms (e.g. `frdm_k64f`), the test below causes a bus fault.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

Apply the following patch to create a test case:

```
diff --git a/tests/ztest/base/prj_verbose_0.conf b/tests/ztest/base/prj_verbose_0.conf
index b4903cd10c..7233d69b58 100644
--- a/tests/ztest/base/prj_verbose_0.conf
+++ b/tests/ztest/base/prj_verbose_0.conf
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 CONFIG_ZTEST=y
 CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y
 CONFIG_ZTEST_ASSERT_VERBOSE=0
+CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE=y
diff --git a/tests/ztest/base/src/main.c b/tests/ztest/base/src/main.c
index 07fc9eb474..21d7c0e14d 100644
--- a/tests/ztest/base/src/main.c
+++ b/tests/ztest/base/src/main.c
@@ -35,6 +35,11 @@ ZTEST(framework_tests, test_assert_mem_equal)
        zassert_mem_equal(actual, expected, sizeof(expected), NULL);
 }
 
+ZTEST_USER(framework_tests, test_userspace_is_user)
+{
+       zassert_true(k_is_user_context(), NULL);
+}
+
 /***************************************************************************************************
  * Sample fixture tests
  **************************************************************************************************/
```

comments:
@henrikbrixandersen The issue is that `config TEST_USERSPACE` in `subsys/testsuite/Kconfig` does have the line `depends on USERSPACE`. The definition of `ZTEST_USER` in `ztest_test_new.h` switches off of `CONFIG_USERSPACE` to see if userspace exists.

I might even argue that `CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE` shouldn't even exist?

Possible solutions for you:
1. Add `CONFIG_USERSPACE=y`
2. Same as 1, but also add the dependency to `TEST_USERSPACE`
3. Get rid of `TEST_USERSPACE`

I would opt for 3, because I don't see the benefit of having a test specific config for userspace.

`CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE=y` is a "soft" version of `CONFIG_USERSPACE=y` which only enables userspace if the architecture/SoC supports it, allowing tests to run in userspace where possible but not preventing the same test to run on a platform without userspace support.

Having to force `CONFIG_USERSPACE=y` in order to use `CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y` is a step backwards compared to our older ztest framework.
Gotcha, it's easy to swap it over. I wasn't aware of the "soft" version.
The fix that closed this was reverted because it caused failures on the nightly build. There's a new PR https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/45262 for review to fix this.
